author: Ryan McCaffrey
description: There's been a slow, steady revival of the styling of early 3D games. With the captivating look of low-polygon worlds – designed around clear technical limitations, but still brimming with craft – many indie games like Derelikt and Crow Country aimed to recreate the visual style and aesthetic of games from the console era of the PS1, Sega Saturn, and N64. In doing so, it gives new and returning generations of players an appreciation for the style of early 3D games. This is especially true for games looking to recreate the eeriness of that low-polygon aesthetic for new horror experiences, such as the upcoming Echograph.
title: Echograph Is a Retro-3D Survival Horror Game That’s Equal Parts Resident Evil and Pokemon Snap
